verse.verse_1: Alif Lam Ra. These are the verses of a clear Book, the Quran.
verse.verse_2: A time will surely come when those who are bent on denying the truth will wish that they had surrendered themselves to God,
verse.verse_3: so leave them to eat and enjoy themselves and let them be beguiled by vain hopes; for soon they will realise [the truth].
verse.verse_4: We have never destroyed a township without a definite decree having been issued;
verse.verse_5: no people can forestall their doom, nor can they delay it.
verse.verse_6: They say, "You to whom the Reminder [the Quran] has been sent down, you are surely possessed.
verse.verse_7: Why do you not bring down the angels upon us, if you are truthful?"
verse.verse_8: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then they will not be reprieved.
verse.verse_9: It is We who have sent down the Reminder and We will, most surely, safeguard it.
verse.verse_10: We sent messengers before you to the previous peoples,
verse.verse_11: but there was never a messenger who came to them but they mocked him:
verse.verse_12: thus We cause this [habit of mocking] to enter into the hearts of the sinful.
verse.verse_13: They will not believe in it, though they have before them the example of former peoples,
verse.verse_14: and even if We opened to them a door from heaven, and they began ascending through it,
verse.verse_15: they would still say, "Our eyes have been dazzled. We are bewitched."
verse.verse_16: We have placed constellations in heaven and have beautified it for beholders,
verse.verse_17: and We have guarded it from every accursed devil:
verse.verse_18: but if anyone eavesdrops, he is pursued by a bright flaming fire.
verse.verse_19: We have spread out the earth, and set upon it firm mountains and caused everything to grow in due proportion.
verse.verse_20: We have provided therein a means of livelihood for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.
verse.verse_21: There is not a thing but its storehouses are with Us. But We only send down each thing in an appropriate measure:
verse.verse_22: We let loose fertilizing winds, and bring water from the sky for you to drink; and you could not have stored it up for yourselves.
verse.verse_23: Truly, it is We who bring to life and We who cause death and We are the inheritor of all things.
verse.verse_24: We know those who lived before you and those who will come after you.
verse.verse_25: It is your Lord who will gather them. He is all wise and all knowing.
verse.verse_26: We created man out of dry clay, from moulded mud,
verse.verse_27: and the jinn We had created before from flaming fire.
verse.verse_28: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am about to bring into being a man wrought from mud.
verse.verse_29: When I have formed him and breathed My spirit into him, fall down in prostration before him,"
verse.verse_30: then the angels all prostrated themselves together.
verse.verse_31: But Satan did not; he refused to join those who prostrated themselves.
verse.verse_32: God asked him, "What is the matter with you, that you are not among those who have prostrated themselves?"
verse.verse_33: He replied, "I am not one to prostrate myself to a man whom You have created out of a clay of moulded mud."
verse.verse_34: God said, "Then get out of here; for you are accursed,
verse.verse_35: and the curse shall be on you till the Day of Judgement!"
verse.verse_36: Satan said, "O my Lord! Grant me respite till the Day of Resurrection."
verse.verse_39: He said, "My Lord, since You have let me go astray. I shall make the path of error seem alluring to them on the earth and shall mislead them all,
verse.verse_41: God said, "This is the path which leads straight to Me.
verse.verse_42: Surely, you shall have no power over My true servants, except those misguided ones who choose to follow you.
verse.verse_43: Surely, Hell is the place to which they are destined,
verse.verse_44: it has seven gates: and each gate has a portion of them allotted to it.
verse.verse_45: Truly, the God-fearing shall dwell amid gardens and fountains --
verse.verse_47: We shall cleanse their hearts of all traces of ill-will; they will be like brethren seated on couches facing one another.
verse.verse_48: They will not be affected by any weariness there, and they will never be made to leave."
verse.verse_49: Tell My servants that I alone am the Forgiving, the Merciful One,
verse.verse_50: and that My punishment is a painful punishment.
verse.verse_52: when they came to him they greeted him with: "Peace." He said,"We feel afraid of you."
verse.verse_53: They said, "Do not be afraid. We come to you with good news. You shall have a son who shall be endowed with great knowledge."
verse.verse_54: He said, "Do you bring me such news despite my old age? What kind of good news are you bringing me?"
verse.verse_55: They said, "We have, indeed, given you glad tidings in truth; do not therefore despair."
verse.verse_56: He said, "Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?"
verse.verse_57: Then he asked, "What then is your business, O messengers?"
verse.verse_58: They said, "We have been sent forth to a guilty people."
verse.verse_59: Except for Lot's household, all of whom we shall rescue,
verse.verse_60: except his wife. We have decreed that she will be among those who remain behind [and will be lost].
verse.verse_61: When the messengers came to Lot and his family,
verse.verse_63: They said, "No, but we bring you news about what they disputed,
verse.verse_64: and we have come to you with the truth, and surely we are truthful,
verse.verse_65: so leave with your family some time in the latter part of the night, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded."
verse.verse_66: We communicated to him Our decree that the guilty ones would be destroyed by the morning.
verse.verse_67: The people of the town came along, revelling,
verse.verse_68: and he told them, "These are my guests, so do not disgrace me.
verse.verse_69: Fear God and do not shame me."
verse.verse_70: They said, "Did we not forbid you to extend hospitality to strangers?"
verse.verse_71: He said, "Here are my daughters, if you must act in this way."
verse.verse_72: By your life, they wandered on in their wild intoxication
verse.verse_73: and thereupon the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at sunrise.
verse.verse_74: We turned the town upside down and rained upon them stones of clay.
verse.verse_75: There are certainly signs in that for those who can learn a lesson --
verse.verse_76: it is still there on the highway --
verse.verse_77: surely in this there is a sign for those who believe.
verse.verse_78: The people of the Wood were also surely wrongdoers.
verse.verse_79: So We took vengeance on them. Both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.
verse.verse_80: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:
verse.verse_81: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.
verse.verse_82: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security --
verse.verse_83: the blast overtook them early one morning.
verse.verse_84: All that they had acquired was of no avail to them.
verse.verse_85: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two in accordance with the requirements of truth and wisdom. The Hour is surely coming. So overlook [their faults] with gracious forgiveness.
verse.verse_86: Surely your Lord is the All Knowing Creator!
verse.verse_87: We have given you the seven oft-recited verses and the great Quran.
verse.verse_88: Do not strain your eyes towards the worldly benefits We have bestowed on some of them, nor grieve on their account. Lower your wing of mercy for the believers
verse.verse_89: and say, "I am, indeed, a plain warner,"
verse.verse_90: such as We send down for those who are divisive,
verse.verse_91: and who have broken the Scripture into fragments --
verse.verse_92: by your Lord, We shall question them all
verse.verse_93: about whatever they had been doing!
verse.verse_94: Proclaim openly what you are commanded, and avoid the polytheists.
verse.verse_95: We will, surely, suffice you against those who mock,
verse.verse_96: who set up another god with God, but they shall soon learn.
verse.verse_97: We do indeed know how your heart is distressed at what they say.
verse.verse_98: But glorify your Lord with His praise, and prostrate yourself:
verse.verse_99: and worship your Lord until what is certain [death] comes to you.
